description:
Korea’s Best Foley Artist Bringing Game Sounds to Life

Hello, this is King Process.
Today, we visited NC Sound Studio to see how the sounds inside video games are made.
The footsteps, impact sounds, and weapon sounds we hear so naturally while playing games
are actually created and refined by Foley artists, matched carefully to every movement on screen.
Even the smallest action needs the right sound.
Using different props, materials, and techniques, they create game sounds that feel more real than real.
Korea’s best Foley artist bringing game sounds to life.
Please enjoy watching the process.
